name: autosomal dominant distal renal tubular acidosis
description: Autosomal dominant distal renal tubular acidosis (AD dRTA) is an inherited form of distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) characterized by hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis often but not always associated with hypokalemia.
